ideas.label: Space Advantage
ideas.principle: Use space to improve pieces, not merely to claim territory.
ideas.summary: - Use extra room to improve pieces and restrict the opponent. - Support the base of the advanced chain so space does not become a target.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: you claimed useful space that restricts their pieces
slots.attention: the space edge still needs piece support at the chain base
slots.lesson: use space to improve pieces, not merely to claim empty territory
slots.plan: reinforce the base, then improve the worst-placed piece

ideas.label: Space Advantage
ideas.principle: Convert space by restricting counterplay before opening lines.
ideas.summary: - Prevent the freeing break before releasing central tension. - Prepare the lever on the side your chain points toward.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: space already limits their freeing ideas
slots.attention: their freeing break still needs restraining before you open lines
slots.lesson: convert space by stopping counterplay before releasing the centre
slots.plan: prepare the wing lever only after the freeing break is under control

ideas.label: Space Advantage
ideas.principle: Break beside the head of the pawn chain only after completing development.
ideas.summary: - Support the lever with pieces before expanding beside the chain head. - Pushing without control trades space for their activity.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: development is ready to support a space-gaining lever
slots.attention: the lever beside the chain head still lacks piece support
slots.lesson: break beside the chain head only after pieces cover the resulting files
